title: FINAL FANTASY VI
description: The Pixel Remaster of FINAL FANTASY VI preserves its ensemble story, Active Time Battle combat, Espers, and iconic soundtrack with modern UI and convenience options. The early game follows an empire, resistance movement, and a mysterious young woman connected to magic. Players can recover companions, complete optional stories, and prepare to confront Kefka’s final domain.

gameplayPillars.title: Large ensemble cast
gameplayPillars.description: The story distributes major roles across Terra, Locke, Celes, Edgar, Sabin, Cyan, and many other characters.

gameplayPillars.title: Esper and magic growth
gameplayPillars.description: Espers teach magic and can influence character development as the party levels.

gameplayPillars.title: Active Time Battle
gameplayPillars.description: Classic ATB combat combines character-specific abilities with spells, equipment, and status strategy.

gameplayPillars.title: Pixel Remaster enhancements
gameplayPillars.description: Updated pixel art, rearranged soundtrack options, modern UI, and convenience boosts improve accessibility.

gameplayPillars.title: World-changing second half
gameplayPillars.description: The game dramatically reshapes its world and party structure, creating one of the series’ most memorable late-game arcs.
